integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic realism at a modern coastal railway platform during warm late-afternoon light. A young adult woman with short curly black hair wears a mustard-yellow raincoat and a navy-blue backpack. She stands beside a small white-and-brown dog wearing a red collar and holds a bright red paper ticket in her right hand. A clean overhead sign reads "PLATFORM 4". The camera begins in a medium-wide view and slowly pushes in while wind moves her coat and the dog's fur; keep the woman's face, hairstyle, clothing, backpack, the dog's markings, collar, and the ticket consistent throughout.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, a gust pulls the red ticket from her hand. The camera cuts to a low tracking shot as the ticket skims along the platform and the dog runs after it, weaving around one bench without colliding with anyone. The woman follows several steps behind. The ticket remains clearly red and the same dog remains in frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a steady medium shot near the platform clock. A station worker catches the ticket and hands it back to the woman. She accepts it with her right hand, checks that it is the same red ticket, smiles with relief, and says in a natural, grateful voice (S1), <d>[English] Thank you. I thought I'd missed it.</d> The dog stops beside her left leg and looks up at her.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, a silver passenger train arrives behind them and slows to a smooth stop. The camera arcs gently around the woman as the doors open. She secures the red ticket in her coat pocket, boards with the navy-blue backpack, then turns and waves once through the open doorway. The dog remains safely on the platform beside the station worker. End on a stable wide composition with the woman visible in the train doorway, the dog and worker on the platform, and the "PLATFORM 4" sign still readable.

overall_soundscape: Continuous coastal wind, distant gulls, soft station ambience, footsteps, paper flutter, the dog's running paws and one short bark. The worker catches the ticket with a crisp paper snap; the approaching train adds rail vibration, braking hiss, a soft arrival chime, and opening-door sounds. Dialogue remains clear above the environment.

non_diegetic_music: Light acoustic guitar with restrained strings at a moderate tempo. The rhythm builds gently during the ticket chase, softens under the spoken line, and resolves on a warm sustained chord as the train doors open.

## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

## Model Links

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)


## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
